create_unifiable_class: create a decorator to register unify and reify operations on a Python class with __dict__ or __slots__
test_unify_object: test the unify_object function to unify two Python objects by type and attribute values
test_reify_object: test the reify_object function to substitute variables in a Python object with concrete values
test_unify_slice: test the _unify dispatcher function to unify two Python slice objects by start, stop, and step
test_reify_slice: test the _reify dispatcher function to substitute variables inside a Python slice object
